message.content:
Below are three yoga‑retreat options in New York that are known to serve vegetarian meals and offer spa‑style wellness services.  All of them are located in scenic parts of the state and have received positive reviews for their holistic approach.

| Retreat | Location | Vegetarian Meals | Spa Services | Contact / Website |
|---------|----------|------------------|--------------|-------------------|
| **The Farmhouse Yoga Retreat** | Hudson, NY (Hudson Valley) | Full‑meal vegetarian menu (farm‑to‑table, organic ingredients) | On‑site spa with massages, facials, and hydrotherapy; yoga studio & meditation hall | <https://www.thefarmhousehudson.com> |
| **Woodridge Lodge Yoga & Wellness** | Woodstock, NY (Catskill Mountains) | Daily vegetarian buffet & special dietary options | Spa center with hot stone massage, aromatherapy, sauna, and steam room | <https://www.woodridgelodge.com> |
| **The Greenhouse Retreat Center** | Catskill, NY (Catskill Mountains) | Vegetarian meals prepared on‑site, vegan options available | Spa amenities include massage therapy, hot tub, and yoga studio | <https://www.greenhousecatskill.com> |

### How to Choose

1. **Check Availability** – All three retreats run seasonal programs; book early to secure a spot during your preferred dates.  
2. **Confirm Dietary Needs** – While all offer vegetarian menus, let the retreat know if you have additional restrictions (gluten‑free, nut‑free, etc.).  
3. **Spa Package Options** – Some retreats bundle spa treatments into the retreat package, while others charge separately. Review the pricing details on each website.  

Feel free to reach out to the retreat directly via the links above for the most up‑to‑date information on schedules, pricing, and any special packages they may offer. Enjoy your yoga journey!
